notes.title: 修复BUG，更新存档系统，遇到存档问题的看过来哦！
notes.notes:
This update not only fixes some bugs related to resource loading but also addresses some issues with save files. If you encounter any save errors, you can place your old save files in the new save folder.
The save folder is located at the installation directory \www\save.

notes.title: Improved with bug fixes, easier puzzles, and more hints
notes.notes:
Fixed some minor bugs such as incorrect picture display and save errors. 
Lowered the difficulty of some puzzles such as the duck puzzle. 
Added hints about specific content.

notes.title: fix game bugs
notes.notes: This game is our first independent game. Because we are not familiar with the platform mechanism of steam, some resources in the game cannot be used normally in the game after the release. Now we have carried out a wave of repairs, hoping to solve these problems.
